initial_plan.can_answer: yes, subject to checking date coverage and the completeness of the pedestrian-fatality field; this file describes NYC police-reported crashes and pedestrian fatalities in them
initial_plan.metric: annual total of number_of_pedestrians_killed, interpreted as pedestrian deaths in police-reported motor vehicle crashes
initial_plan.denominator: not applicable; this is a count, not a rate or share
initial_plan.population: all crash rows in NYC with crash_date in calendar years 2013 through 2025 inclusive; sum pedestrian deaths, not crash records

data_check.facts_meaning: There are 2,132,218 crash rows dated in 2013-2025, with records in every year. The date endpoints in each year span January 1 through December 31, including 2025; this establishes observed endpoint coverage, not whether every report has been filed. No selected row has a missing crash_date or pedestrian-fatality value. No candidate default dates (0001-01-01, 1900-01-01, or 1970-01-01) occur in the selected population; DATE typing precludes non-date or impossible date strings. Thus the check identified no selected rows to exclude or reclassify, and all selected rows are retained. The population counts police-reported NYC motor vehicle crash records, with the pedestrian fatality field totaled across those records.

decisions.crash_date: Keep all rows in the requested date range; none of the selected rows has a missing date or candidate default date, and each year's observed endpoints span the calendar year.
decisions.number_of_pedestrians_killed: Keep all rows; none of the selected rows has this field missing. Sum this field as recorded.

final_plan.can_answer: yes, as counts recorded for police-reported NYC motor vehicle crashes
final_plan.metric: sum of number_of_pedestrians_killed by calendar year of crash_date; counts pedestrian deaths, not crashes
final_plan.denominator: not applicable; annual count, not a rate or share
final_plan.population: all police-reported NYC motor vehicle crash rows with crash_date in calendar years 2013 through 2025 inclusive; each row contributes its recorded pedestrian-killed count
final_plan.row_handling: Retain every in-range row; do not exclude rows, and sum the pedestrian-killed field as recorded.
final_plan.limitations: These are counts in police-reported crash records, not a count independently validated against person-level death records. Observed dates span January 1 to December 31 in every requested year, including 2025, and no selected row has a missing pedestrian-killed value; endpoint coverage does not independently establish complete reporting.
